title: Near-regular hypergraph matchings and the asymptotic triangle-packing gap
abstract: A Lean 4 / Mathlib formalization of three results. (1) A finite nibble theorem: r-uniform hypergraphs whose degrees are at most (1+μ)d everywhere and at least (1−μ)d outside an exceptional set of at most η|V| vertices, with codegrees at most μd, have matchings with at least (1−β)|V|/r edges. (2) The fractional–integral triangle-packing gap is o(n²) uniformly over finite graphs: every large graph has an edge-disjoint triangle family P such that every fractional triangle packing has weight at most |P| + εn² (the triangle case of Haxell–Rödl). (3) The cover form: a fractional triangle cover of weight at most |P| + εn² exists. The proof combines a nibble with second-moment and Freedman-type concentration, a low-degree core reduction, Mathlib's Szemerédi regularity lemma with a cluster linear program rounded by explicit designs, and LP duality.
